digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate integration (SOTA task-decomposition recommendations R1-R7)
propositions: Seven SOTA task-decomposition recommendations (R1-R7) must be integrated into the plan-review gate with eval-based validation or advisory-first safety posture instead of blocking implementation without evidence.

Original batch-eval gating strategy was operator-approved descoped and replaced with advisory-first posture plus standing dogfood monitoring via d8a5 (criterion_effectiveness.py) to manage LLM spend and human-adjudication budget.
E1 finding-adjudication/inter-rater-kappa corpus was invalidated (tool-less, plan-truncated labeling ~79% contaminated) and descoped; only the outcome corpus (628 rows) was frozen and committed.
E2/E3 expensive LLM batch baseline was permanently rejected and superseded by d8a5 zero-LLM standing effectiveness recorder; deterministic corpus/harness were WIP only.

All R1-R7 children must land through Gerrit with operator-approved gate terms; advisory criteria enter the packaged registry directly (no config-flag overlay gating) and promotion to blocking requires accumulated dogfood evidence (≤10% blocking-FP proxy threshold).
R2 grounding correction: operator-attested DET lint is a P6-family static floor check (det_floor.py) and does NOT touch criteria_routing.json; R3/R4 remain serialized on that file to avoid conflicts.
